create_redline.ponder.steam_redliner.tex: The Steam Redliner runs on a 3x3x3 Fluid Tank over 9 Blaze Burners
Every burner must be superheated with Blaze Cake, and the tank kept supplied with water
Place the Steam Redliner on the centre of a side or the top. It covers the whole 3x3 face
It produces 4x the stress capacity of the 9 Steam Engines this boiler could run
The Large Cogwheel it was crafted with sets the rotor: Allthemodium 512 RPM, Vibranium 2048 RPM, Unobtainium 8192 RPM
Stress capacity stays the same, but the output shaft must match the rotor's tier
Only one Redliner fits on each boiler, and no Steam Engines can share its tank
